full_judgment:
“Whether on the basis of the deed of partnership executed on the 10th May, 1957, registration claimed for the previous year from 1st April 1957 to 31st of March, 1958 was rightly refused for the fax year 1958-59?” 

 12. On a difference of opinion between the learned Judges of the Division Bench of the High Court of East Pakistan before which the Reference originally came up for hearing, the case was referred to a third Judge. The majority judgment was challenged in the appeal to the then Supreme Court. Having considered numerous decisions of various High Courts and also having noticed the earlier amendment in section 26A substituting the word "by" for the word "under" by the amendment of 1957, their Lordships agreed with the dissenting judgment of the High Court which had held "that the registration of the partnership firm as evidenced by the partnership deed executed on the 10th May, 1957, for the account period from 1st April 1957 to 9th May 1957 was rightly refused by the Income-tax Tribunal in terms of section 26A(1) of the Act, but it could not be so refused for the period from 10th May 1957 to 31st March, 1958."
